notes.A: The desktop node graph has numbered edges but a tangled reading order, tiny text, and the four layers are shown only as stray boxes and a bullet list, while at 390 px the canvas is clipped and the diagram is mostly unreadable, so the explanatory cards carry the content.
notes.B: The swimlane reads cleanly on desktop with a good focal catalog hand-off, and the mobile version stacks into a single readable column, but the four layers are just a text aside and card, and the desktop has wasted space and tiny in-box text.
notes.C: The two labelled bands for add and find, with a middle four-layers panel tied together by the catalog.json callout, give the clearest newcomer flow, and the numbered steps reflow to a clean single column on mobile with legible type.
